main_text.p: fis, contraque gratiam & offensam infra-cc ctis fuerit commissum. Accessit proximiscc annis totidem virorum collegium terti-Quæstores bonorum monasticorum um, cui cura demandata est bonorum monasticorum totius provinciæ, quæ pri-us ad collegium primum pertinebat. Causa instituti hujus fuit, quòd credere-tur, collegium primum rebus omnibus, quæ illi commissæ erant, non sufficere. Sedent in eo duo à senatu oppidano dati è civium numero, duo ab ordinibus agrariis ex eorundem medio. Designantur in comitiis. Curatio eorum annua, nisi fiat prorogatio, quæ fit sæpè. Duo ex his, alter ex oppidanis ex agrariis alter, actorum & rationum indices aut libros tenentur conficere, capiuntque stipendium è publico Carolinos aureos ccc; cæteri verò cc tantùm. Omnes, cùm locandum aliquid, aut controversia inter Quæstorem & conductores finienda, quod officii eorum est, ex Sex-viris collegii primi duos sibi adjungunt, oppidanum unum, agrarium alterum, & cum his expediunt omnia, aut si major controversia sit, quàm ut expediri ab ipsis rectè possit, remittunt

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("fis,") continuing from the previous page; the first letter of "ctis" is partly covered by the line end and is read as "ctis" (probably infra-ctis). The marginal "cc" marks are read as printed; their function is unclear. Print appears slightly blurred in the lower right, with digitiser text ignored. Note "Quæstores" is read as a single side note spanning the lines "bonorum monasticorum"; the exact line division of the note is uncertain.
